items.title: ‘Super Coupon Club’ is all about counting coupons
items.en_title: ‘Super Coupon Club’ is all about counting coupons
items.en_oneliner: Super Coupon Club is a game about counting coupons, where players must shop carefully with coupons and aim to come out ahead at checkout.

items.title: GDCA 2027 moves away from nominations-based system, publishers and devs can now submit games for consideration
items.en_title: GDCA 2027 moves away from nominations-based system, publishers and devs can now submit games for consideration
items.en_oneliner: The 2027 Game Developers Choice Awards GDCA dropped the nominations system, with publishers and developers now able to submit games for consideration themselves.

items.title: Activision QA United-CWA union vote to authorise strike, claims publisher has "failed to bargain in good faith over key issues"
items.en_title: Activision QA United-CWA union vote to authorise strike, claims publisher has "failed to bargain in good faith over key issues"
items.en_oneliner: Activision's QA union voted to authorize a strike if necessary, accusing the publisher of failing to bargain in good faith on key issues, with the labor struggle's progress worth industry attention.

items.title: New Croatian conference Splitscreen wants to keep "that half-holiday, half-work feeling" of Reboot Develop
items.en_title: New Croatian conference Splitscreen wants to keep "that half-holiday, half-work feeling" of Reboot Develop
items.en_oneliner: The new Croatian conference Splitscreen aims to succeed the discontinued Reboot Develop, keeping its half-holiday half-work atmosphere, giving European developers another gathering option.

items.title: Tiny City
items.en_oneliner: Kenney released a free 2D mini city asset pack with 130 files, suited to quickly building pixel-art city prototypes.
